instruction: Keep going to the next song on Spotify until you reach a song I have already liked.
notes: The queue is modeled as a representative linear chain song-a -> song-b -> song-c with song-c liked; (next-in-queue ...) and (liked ...) are world facts in :init gated by the knowledge predicates (queue-known)/(liked-known), which the agent obtains via show_song_queue and show_liked_songs (paginate at runtime). spotify-next-song advances the cursor and is only applicable while the current song is not liked, so the plan cannot overshoot the first liked song; at runtime next_song is repeated until the current song id is in the liked set. spotify-show-current-song is the verification step: it observes the current song and, when that song is in the liked set, asserts (reached-liked-song), the sole task-specific goal and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task (no answer required). Only the music player cursor changes, matching the evaluation (single MusicPlayer update of cursor_position).
